title: Outcomes of accelerated collagen cross linking in progressive paediatric keratoconus

license.statement: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (article <license-p>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 License; the XML gives no licence URL)

groups.description: 64 eyes of 39 patients aged 18 years or younger (range 9-18) with progressive keratoconus; epithelium-off accelerated CXL, UVA 365 nm at 9 mW/cm2 for 10 minutes after 20 minutes of riboflavin (isotonic 0.1% riboflavin in 20% dextran if thinnest pachymetry > 450 um, hypotonic riboflavin otherwise); prospective, 1-year follow-up

series.notes: mean ± SD (Statistical analysis: data expressed as mean ± standard deviation); unit D printed in the preoperative cell and stated in the abstract; Pentacam (Oculus) Scheimpflug tomography per Methods; 1 year = 12 months; per-visit n not reported (64 eyes included)

exclusions.what: follow-up visits at days 1 and 5 and months 1, 3 and 6
exclusions.reason: Kmax not tabulated at these visits (only preoperative and 1 year)

exclusions.what: isotonic (33 eyes) and hypotonic (31 eyes) riboflavin subgroups
exclusions.reason: not tabulated separately; only the whole cohort is tabulated, so the whole cohort is extracted

exclusions.what: the two eyes with progression at final follow-up (Results text)
exclusions.reason: subset selected by a post-treatment outcome; no Kmax series given

notes: Exclusion criteria of the study included patients who did not complete the 1-year follow-up; the article reports no larger treated group, so the 64 included eyes are kept as the study cohort (not an outcome-selected subset).
Table 1 also gives UCVA, BCVA, mean corneal astigmatism, K1, K2, CCT, thinnest corneal thickness and endothelial cell count (not extracted).
The Kmax row of Table 1 agrees with the Results text in column order (preoperative, then 1 year).
